summary: Phase 3 (Workflow Builder + Onboarding Reset) tested end-to-end. Backend pytest 17/17 passed covering: RBAC gating on /api/v1/workflows (admin+process_admin allowed; sales_head, accounts_support, partner all 403), full CRUD (create/get/update/delete), tally counting for whatsapp/email/task/trigger/condition/fallback, activate flipping status to 'active', validation (name required), onboarding/reset RBAC (admin+process_admin 200, sales_head+accounts 403), and Phase 1/2 regressions (partner /leads 403, accounts_support cannot edit lead, sales_head can edit, forced password change 409 gate, impersonation admin-only). Frontend UI: process_admin can open #/workflows and sees the full mission-control builder — workflow-builder root, wf-palette (all 8 palette nodes: trigger, send_whatsapp, send_email, condition, task, status_change, wait, fallback), wf-canvas, wf-config, floating toolbar (zoom-in/out/clear), topbar buttons (save/validate/activate/exit), and Mission Checklist tally rows (whatsapptemplates/emailtemplates/tasktypes/totalnodes). Programmatic HTML5 drag-drop successfully created 4 nodes (1 trigger, 2 send_whatsapp, 1 send_email) and live tally correctly updated to WA=2, Email=1, Total=4. Save flow persisted to backend (POST /workflows) and reloading #/workflows re-imported the same 4 nodes. Direct activate-flow API call (with connected graph) confirmed status flips to 'active' and tally recomputes correctly on the server. sales_head has NO 'Flow Builder' nav item and cannot see the builder when navigating directly (API returns 403). Super-admin dashboard shows the 'Restart setup' button (ob-restart) inside the onboarding-timeline banner.
critical_code_review_comments: WorkflowController::update accepts partial payloads but requires 'name' (required rule) on every PUT. If UI ever sends a partial update it would 422. Currently workflow.js always sends name+graph so it's fine, but consider 'sometimes|required' on update.

WorkflowController does not scope queries to created_by — any user with workflow.manage can list/edit/delete all workflows. Fine for single-tenant admin usage, but note the model has 'created_by' yet index() returns everyone's rows. If future roles are given workflow.manage-scoped, add ownership check.

workflow.js activate() calls validate() first; if validation fails the badge never updates and toast shows the first error only. Good UX, but the request states 'Activate validates+saves then POST activate' — confirmed correct implementation.

workflow.js currentGraphCounts() does not count triggers/conditions/fallbacks in the client tally box (only whatsapp/email/task/nodes). Backend tally includes them; consider surfacing those counts to the UI checklist for parity.
OnboardingController::reset uses ->delete() on the whole table (single-tenant OK) but does not audit-log who triggered a reset — worth adding an AuditLog entry.
public/assets/js/workflow.js is ~300 lines and OK, but the T (node registry) config and configFields() would be cleaner split into a config module as more node types are added.
seed_data_creation: Test run created TEST_wf_*, TEST_wf_a_*, TEST_ui_flow workflows (auto-deleted in most tests). Created a few TEST_p3_* leads and TEST_p3fpw_* users during regression tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 fully green. For future retest: reset workflows table via `php artisan tinker --execute="App\Models\Workflow::query()->delete();"` and onboarding via `App\Models\OnboardingState::query()->delete();`. Drawflow UI drag-drop via Playwright is unreliable with real mouse events; use synthetic DragEvent with DataTransfer as done in this iteration's script. The activate button in the UI intentionally blocks when validation fails (unconnected nodes) — to test the badge flipping to 'active', either wire nodes on the canvas first or call POST /workflows/{id}/activate directly. Backend token key in localStorage is 'crm.token'. Tests use pytest-xdist by default (2 workers) and pass both serially and in parallel.
